en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a public square with a tall Gothic-style war memorial featuring a statue beneath an ornate canopy. Surrounding it are late 19th‑/early 20th‑century buildings and a church-like tower. Several people, including children and a woman with a baby carriage, stand near the fenced monument. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the place and publisher.
